Package com.mimecast.robin.config.server

Class DnsConfig

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.config.server.DnsConfig
public class DnsConfig extends Object
Configuration for the dnsjava resolver used by all DNS lookups in Robin (RBL checks, MX resolution, DANE, FCrDNS, etc.).

When servers is empty, the JVM system resolver is used. When one or more servers are listed, an ExtendedResolver is created so that failed or timed-out queries are retried against the next server in the list.

Example config block in server.json5: 

 dns: {
   servers: ["127.0.0.1"],
   timeoutSeconds: 5,
   tcp: false,
   port: 53,
   mxImplicitFallbackEnabled: true,
   mxNullMxHardFailEnabled: true,
   mxAddressFamilyPreference: "ipv4_first"
 }

  • Method Details

    • getServers

      public List<String> getServers()
      DNS server addresses to query. Empty list means use the JVM system resolver (from /etc/resolv.conf).

    • getTimeoutSeconds

      public int getTimeoutSeconds()
      Per-query timeout in seconds. Default: 5.

    • isTcp

      public boolean isTcp()
      Force TCP for all DNS queries instead of UDP. Useful when UDP responses are truncated or for debugging. Default: false.

    • getPort

      public int getPort()
      DNS server port. Default: 53. Override when using a resolver on a non-standard port (e.g. unbound on 5353).

    • isCacheEnabled

      public boolean isCacheEnabled()
      Whether the shared dnsjava response cache is enabled. Default: true. Disable only for debugging — without caching every DNS lookup hits the network.

    • getCacheMaxEntries

      public int getCacheMaxEntries()
      Maximum number of positive (successful) entries in the shared cache. Default: 0 (dnsjava default). Tune this on high-traffic servers where memory is constrained. 0 means use the dnsjava built-in default.

    • getCacheMaxNegativeEntries

      public int getCacheMaxNegativeEntries()
      Maximum number of negative (NXDOMAIN / NODATA) entries in the shared cache. Default: 0 (dnsjava default). Negative caching prevents repeated DNS lookups for non-existent domains. 0 means use the dnsjava built-in default.

    • isMxImplicitFallbackEnabled

      public boolean isMxImplicitFallbackEnabled()
      Enables RFC 5321 implicit MX fallback when no MX records are present. When enabled, delivery can fall back to A/AAAA lookup for the recipient domain. Default: true.

    • isMxNullMxHardFailEnabled

      public boolean isMxNullMxHardFailEnabled()
      Honors RFC 7505 Null MX semantics. When enabled and a domain publishes "MX 0 .", the domain is treated as non-deliverable and no implicit A/AAAA fallback is attempted. Default: true.

    • getMxAddressFamilyPreference

      public String getMxAddressFamilyPreference()
      Preferred address family order when both A and AAAA records are available. Accepted values:
      • ipv4_first (default)
      • ipv6_first
      • system
